reference: GraphCast precipitation methodology, cited by GenCast Appendix F.4 and FGN evaluation
climatology_grouping: calendar month; pool all four six-hourly verification times and all source years
accumulation_source: sum consecutive ERA5 total_precipitation_6hr intervals ending at verification time; retain 18-hour previous-year context
wet_threshold: linear 2/3 quantile of non-dry accumulation samples in the calendar month
dry_fraction: monthly fraction of all accumulation samples strictly below dry threshold
aggregation: area-weighted mean for each case/lead then equal-date mean; report valid area
comparison_to_weatherbenchx: Same scoring matrix; provide paper monthly p1 rather than WBX annual-mean p1; strict dry boundary follows paper prose rather than WBX <= convention
